answer: Faking a thousand identities means capital locked per identity plus forfeiture on failed verification, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while honest gains stay intact. Sybil resistance here relies on a stake-weighted identity mirror: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers cross-check that bond against an on-chain ridge of prior attestations. A pigment of uniqueness, the bond cannot be recycled across clones. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
